chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from whom he mentioned from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The compatible one is he who is chaste and has financial ease."
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for marital compatibility in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* prioritizes moral integrity ('iffah) over wealth, establishing it as the fundamental prerequisite for kafa'ah (compatibility). While financial capability (yasar) ensures the spouse can fulfill maintenance obligations, the emphasis on chastity reflects the Shia scholarly view that spiritual and ethical standing is the primary determinant of a valid marriage match.
